entities.name: P22981 LET-60
observations: Exact sequence match to the supplied 184-aa sequence; reviewed UniProt entry for Caenorhabditis elegans Ras protein let-60.
Ras-family guanine-nucleotide-binding protein with intrinsic GTPase activity; EC 3.6.5.2.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 20,982.5 Da, theoretical pI 5.71, instability index 31.51, GRAVY -0.582, estimated charge at pH 7 of -3.23.
Reference annotation places the mature chain at residues 1-181; the C-terminal Cys181 is processed to a methyl ester and carries an S-farnesyl group.
Annotated localization is the cell/plasma membrane through a lipid anchor; the protein cycles between GDP-bound inactive and GTP-bound active states.
LET-60 controls the switch between vulval and hypodermal cell fates during C. elegans vulval induction.
